image_description: A live concert performance scene featuring three musicians on an elevated stage. The central figure is a male guitarist wearing a cap and playing an electric guitar. To the right, two female vocalists stand at microphones. The stage floor appears to be wooden planking with red risers or monitors. In the foreground, large black speaker cabinets and monitor wedges are visible. The background features complex stage lighting rigs with blue and red beams cutting through atmospheric haze/smoke.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers on the fretboard lack clear definition and appear slightly fused or 'melted' into the strings/neck, a common AI generation artifact in complex hand-object interactions.
The bases and lower shafts of the microphone stands appear geometrically inconsistent; they seem to merge with the stage floor or each other without clear mechanical joints or stable footing.
The edges of the black monitor wedges in the foreground show slight warping and non-Euclidean alignment, suggesting minor perspective errors in the rendering of rigid objects.

To assess the realism of lighting effects (haze/beams) and identify any subtle texture inconsistencies in the crowd/background.
